newsitem.title: JAPAN: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - April 24.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - April 24.

text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in the Japanese press on Thursday, as reported by Kyodo news agency.
-- Peruvian government on guard against possible reprisals by Tupac Amaru Revolutionary Movement (MRTA) rebels.
-- Finance Ministry to sell Nippon Telegraph and Telephone Corp stock for first time in nine years.
-- Russia and China agree to set up hot line.
